title: Your Digital Rupee Just Got a Push: What Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Said
description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman recently urged the RBI to speed up the adoption of India's Digital Rupee (e₹). The Digital Rupee is India's own digital cu.

faq.a: The Digital Rupee, or e₹, is India's official Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC), issued by the Reserve Bank of India. It is a digital form of the Indian Rupee, designed to be used like cash but in a virtual format.
The Digital Rupee is issued directly by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). It is a direct liability of the central bank, just like physical currency.

faq.q: How can I get a Digital Rupee wallet?
faq.a: Currently, you can get an e₹ wallet if you are a customer of one of the participating banks in the pilot program. You would download the specific Digital Rupee app from your bank and register using your linked bank account.
Yes, e₹ wallets are designed to be safe and secure. The RBI ensures a robust cybersecurity framework to protect the digital currency in your wallet.

faq.q: Does the Digital Rupee earn interest?
faq.a: No, like physical cash, the Digital Rupee itself does not earn any interest. It is a medium of exchange and a store of value, not an investment instrument.
